<think>Now I have a clear picture. Let me analyze:

1. `package.json` - Uses Node ESM, has test script.
2. `protocol.mjs` - An MCP-like protocol wrapper that takes JSON-RPC requests from stdin and dispatches them to `listTools` and `callTool`.
3. `server.mjs` - Needs implementation of `listTools` and `callTool`.
4. `server.test.mjs` - Has two tests:
   - `create then get`: Creates a note with title 'A' and body 'B', extracts an id matching pattern `/n\d+/` from `c.content[0].text`, then retrieves it and asserts the title 'A' is in the response text.
   - `lists two tools`: Asserts `listTools()` returns exactly 2 tools.

Requirements from the prompt:
- Expose `note_create` with required non-empty `title` and `body`
- Expose `note_get` with required `note_id`
- Store notes in memory
- Return structured text content
- Use stable generated ids (matching `/n\d+/` pattern based on test)
- Reject invalid inputs or unknown tools

The id pattern `/n\d+/` suggests format like `n1`, `n2`, etc. I should use a counter for stable, predictable IDs.

For MCP-style return: structured content with `content: [{type: 'text', text: '...'}]`.

Let me implement this:

```js
const notes = new Map();
let counter = 0;

const tools = [
  {
    name: 'note_create',
    description: 'Create a new note with a title and body.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
        body: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 }
      },
      required: ['title', 'body']
    }
  },
  {
    name: 'note_get',
    description: 'Get a note by its id.',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        note_id: { type: 'string' }
      },
      required: ['note_id']
    }
  }
];

export async function listTools() {
  return tools;
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name === 'note_create') {
    const { title, body } = args || {};
    if (typeof title !== 'string' || title.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid input: title is required and must be non-empty');
    }
    if (typeof body !== 'string' || body.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid input: body is required and must be non-empty');
    }
    counter += 1;
    const id = `n${counter}`;
    notes.set(id, { id, title, body });
    return {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Created note ${id}: ${title}` }]
    };
  }
  
  if (name === 'note_get') {
    const { note_id } = args || {};
    if (typeof note_id !== 'string' || note_id.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('Invalid input: note_id is required');
    }
    const note = notes.get(note_id);
    if (!note) {
      throw new Error(`Note not found: ${note_id}`);
    }
    return {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: `${note.title}\n\n${note.body}` }]
    };
  }
  
  throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
}
```
